snippet.title: Damning Details - Murder Mystery Game Trailer
snippet.description:
Everyone has a secret. One is a killer. The details will damn them.

Damning Details is a murder-mystery game where you search every scene, question every suspect, present the evidence and make deductions until you can prove who did it.

- A tutorial and 3 cases to solve: a storm-bound Cornish country house, a hotel in 1918 Baalbek and an Antarctic research station
- Generate new cases with AI
- Play cases written by the community, or write your own

Play free in your browser: https://damningdetails.com
